metadata.name: Item Weight Editor (道具权重编辑器)
metadata.description: Change any item's drop weight and quality: 0 = never appears, 0.5 = half as often, 1 = unchanged. Also lets you override an item's quality (used by Highlight Review for 4-tier judgement). Requires REPENTOGON. / 自定义任意道具的掉落权重与评级：0 = 不出现，0.5 = 出现率减半，1 = 不变。也可以覆盖道具评级（高光回顾会用它判四级）。需要 REPENTOGON。
